description: This file contains an extension to the CronJobEditor class, implementing helper functions for UI rendering, data hydration, payload construction, validation, and schedule management related to cron jobs in the application.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a stylized text label for a grid layout in the UI.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's state from a given CronJob object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Attempts to build and save the payload; handles errors during building process.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a payload dictionary representing the cron job data, ready for saving or transmission.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Builds a delivery configuration dictionary based on the current editor state.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates that the name field is non-empty, throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Constructs a schedule dictionary based on the selected schedule type.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload for system events or agent turns based on the current payload type.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates the session target consistency with payload kind, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Ensures required fields are present in the payload, throws error otherwise.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Determines whether to set deleteAfterRun based on schedule and class state.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload dictionary for agent turn actions.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string (e.g., '10m') into milliseconds.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Determines the effective raw session target, considering preserved values if isolated.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Checks if the session target is distinct from 'main'.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string.
